Two elevated corridor projects inaugurated in different cities

An elevated corridor project worth Rs 482 crore in Varthur-Gunjur has been progressing slowly for seven years. Separately, a 6.37-km elevated corridor costing Rs 998 crore in Nagpur, connecting Indora and Dighori, was inaugurated. This Nagpur project aims to segregate through and local traffic.
